verse.name: v1
v2
verse.lines:
Ntambula nga sikyatya,
Yesu Mukuumi wange;
Mu biro-eby'enjala-andiisa,
Era bwe nnumwa ennyonta,
Antwala ku mabbali
Ag'amazzi-amateefu.

verse.name: v3
verse.lines:
Si kirungi nsanyuke?
Si kirungi njaguze?
Ne bwe ndifa talindeka
Alintuusa ne mu ggulu,
Eyo gye naabeeranga,
Mu maaso ga Katonda.
